inputs.prompt: Use the supplied feral crouch image as an exact same-character reference. This is the same Korean woman who lived as a plain Joseon inn hostess, now the gumiho boss in phase ONE of combat. Intensify the animal transformation instead of adding costume. Keep her recognizable amber-eyed adult human face, faded navy work jeogori, off-white collar, dark skirt, worn apron and simple cloth shoes. The apron has slipped sideways; seams are strained and dusty, but her body stays fully covered. Her hairpin has fallen out and black hair hangs wild around her face. Her expression is a raw, controlled predator's snarl: brows lowered, upper lip lifted to show small foxlike fangs, narrow pupils, no cute smile, no screaming. Russet-black fur spreads irregularly across both forearms, neck and shoulder line; hands end in long dark claws. Body hunched almost on four limbs, spine curved, one hand gripping rough stone and both feet braced for a physical lunge. Nine heavy, rough charcoal fox tails connect organically at the lower back; they whip low across the dusty floor, not arranged as a symmetrical fan. Three-quarter low camera, full head-to-toe figure and all tails visible with margin. Unadorned underground Gumiwon seal chamber, broken cup and stone, dark Korean fantasy game concept, matte painting, slight inked edges, readable isometric silhouette. One body, one face, two arms and legs, coherent hands and shoes. No ornate dress, jewelry, crown, armor, fox-ear costume, full animal muzzle, bare skin, magic glow, fire or text. This is the physical first phase, not the later elemental phase.
